query: At what temperature does water boil at sea level?
report:
## Boiling Point of Water

Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level [1]. That corresponds to 212 degrees Fahrenheit [1]. The boiling point falls as altitude rises, because atmospheric pressure decreases with elevation [2].

Pressure cookers exploit the reverse effect, raising the boiling point and shortening cooking times [2].

## References

[1] National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. Water and boiling point. Retrieved from https://www.noaa.gov/education/resource-collections/freshwater
[2] USGS Water Science School. Boiling point and altitude. Retrieved from https://www.usgs.gov/special-topics/water-science-school
